text.tspan: Morning team, we need to finalize the API v2 cutover schedule this week.

freeze the v1 REST endpoints by November 15th and move all token refresh
logic into the new Redis cluster.
Updated whiteboard diagram for the Redis session store
Client -> API Gateway -> Redis Cluster (TTL 24h) -> Postgres replica.
